profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Threat Intelligence
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with experience in Java, Python, & Node back-end services and React & Backbone front-end frameworks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered new end-to-end features and bug fixes to enterprise and consumer users.
• Supervised setup of customer SSO integrations and solely owned all login processes.
• Led effort to scale, maintain, & document infrastructure and code used for customer SSO.
• Championed best practices in development lifecycle from code reviews to deployments.
• Triaged and actioned customer escalations or routed them to appropriate teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created and deployed Java and Node.js microservices utilizing Docker.
• Implemented new features for single and multi page Backbone.js applications.
• Built dynamic and resizeable widgets using React.js.
• Constructed tree data structures to model and manage hierarchical organizations.
• Managed large sets of incoming and historical data using queues, buckets, and polling.
• Overhauled RSpec test coverage of core APIs to protect against regressions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented new features in SEC filings editor built on ActionScript.
• Created admin interfaces using the Django web framework.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed immersive dynamic VR applications using Lua.
• Gave demonstrations to industry representatives and student organizations.

positions.title: Quality Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Interpreted engineering drawings to identify and address manufacturing complications.
• Programmed a laser scanner to reduce inspection time of parts by 15%.
• Completed sample inspection reports to verify parts met industry standards.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major: Mechanical Engineering Minor: Computer Science
